data.name: Repeat_EveryNDays

data.comment: {0}: the number of weeks.

data.name: Repeat_OnDays
data.comment: {0}: "Weekly" or "Every N weeks"; {1}: the days, as "Mon, Fri".

data.name: Repeat_MonthlyOnDay
data.comment: {0}: the day of the month.

data.comment: {0}: the number of months; {1}: the day of the month.

data.name: Repeat_AnnuallyOn
data.comment: {0}: the month's name; {1}: the day of the month.

data.name: Repeat_EveryNYearsOn
data.comment: {0}: the number of years; {1}: the month's name; {2}: the day of the month.

data.name: Repeat_EndAfterTimes
data.comment: {0}: the pattern; {1}: how many times it repeats.

data.name: Repeat_EndUntil
data.comment: {0}: the pattern; {1}: the end date, formatted with Format_EndDate.

data.name: Format_EndDate
data.comment: A .NET date pattern for the end date in Repeat_EndUntil; names come from the user's culture.

data.name: File_NotPendulumFormat
data.value: The file isn't in Pendulum's format.
data.comment: Shown inside the import and restore error messages.

data.name: File_NotReminderList
data.value: The file doesn't hold a list of Pendulum reminders.
data.comment: Shown inside the import error message.

data.name: Repeat_MonthlyOnRelative
data.comment: {0}: the day, as Repeat_RelativeDay says it.

data.name: Repeat_EveryNMonthsOnRelative
data.comment: {0}: the number of months; {1}: the day, as Repeat_RelativeDay.

data.name: Repeat_AnnuallyOnRelative
data.comment: {0}: the day, as Repeat_RelativeDay; {1}: the month's name.

data.name: Repeat_EveryNYearsOnRelative
data.comment: {0}: the number of years; {1}: the day, as Repeat_RelativeDay; {2}: the month's name.

data.name: Repeat_RelativeDay
data.comment: {0}: which, a Week_* word; {1}: a day's name or a DayKind_* word. As "the last Friday".

data.name: DayKind_Day
data.comment: Any day, as "the fourth day".

data.name: File_Unreadable
data.value: Pendulum couldn't read {0}. Another program may have it open: try again in a moment. Nothing was changed.
data.comment: {0}: the data file's full path. Shown when Pendulum stops at startup rather than start without it.
